criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT, pp.2-3: four covered indications (shoulder adhesive capsulitis with nested ALL-of, knee arthrofibrosis, other joint arthrofibrosis, dislocations) then five not-covered statements; LOINC documentation table closes the section before BILLING/CODING.
procedures_covered: Manipulation under anesthesia for adhesive capsulitis of the shoulder
Serial or multi-joint MUA for chronic pain: investigational

logic.top_level: pathways: four indications, one of which (shoulder) has nested ALL-of criteria with a further nested ALL-of for conservative management
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Not-covered statements: spinal MUA; MUA for other joint disorders; serial treatment sessions; multi-joint MUA for chronic pain. Contraindications are not listed.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: 'serial treatment sessions' are investigational; no criteria otherwise for repeat MUA.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Adhesive capsulitis of the shoulder (e.g., frozen shoulder), defined by ALL of the following: Refractory/progressive shoulder pain with functional limitations for at least 6 weeks, AND Persistent limited (at least 50% reduction) active and passive glenohumeral motion, AND Failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative medical management that included the following: Analgesics and/or corticosteroids, unless contraindicated, AND At least 4 weeks of physical therapy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Third item has a nested two-line AND list; it reads as 'analgesics and/or corticosteroids (unless contraindicated) AND >=4 weeks PT', and the 4-week PT is a subset of the 6-week management window; 'and/or' lets either drug class count.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: As a treatment modality for radiographically-confirmed joint dislocations at any joint
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: No further criteria; the CPT list includes closed-treatment-of-dislocation codes that are routine.

vague_terms.problem: no ROM or time-since-surgery criteria for the knee though the log says criteria 'for MUA of the knee' were revised in 2018 and 2023.

extraction_hazards: Three levels of bullets: '•' (4), 'o' (3) and the minus sign U+2212 '−' (2) for the third level; a parser keyed on '•' misses nesting.

LOINC table (4 columns, 6 rows) lives at the end of the Position Statement, introduced by 'LOINC Codes:' and a documentation sentence, then BILLING/CODING; section splitting by heading must account for it.
Description contains a long 'Summary and Analysis of Evidence' with study results (~70 lines).
Typo: 'documentation of failure conservative medical management'.
interesting_structures: Joint-specific criteria with different minimum conservative durations (6 weeks shoulder, 6 weeks PT + splinting other joints).
A definition-style construction 'defined by ALL of the following' for the shoulder indication.
A documentation checklist expressed as a LOINC table with a six-month look-back.
Not-covered statements for combinations (serial, multi-joint, spinal).

fit_to_tree.why: nested all-of fits well with numeric time thresholds; weaker spots are the open 'other joints' branch and undefined 'significant' ROM loss.
